Package CPDFGeneration

Class CEmailOptions

java.lang.Object
CPDFGeneration.CEmailOptions
public final class CEmailOptions extends Object
Email API V1 options, copied at conversion entry. Do not mutate during copying. Zero byte budgets mean zero, not unlimited. The callback remains associated with the result until close, including later exports and PDF writes. Negative budgets are rejected with IllegalArgumentException when passed to a converter. Internal structural limits still apply independently of these budgets. Passing null options to a converter selects defaults.
Since:
1.3.0

  • Field Details

    • API_VERSION

      public static final int API_VERSION
      Native email API version used by this wrapper; not the SDK release version.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • flags

      public int flags
      Bitwise OR of CEmailFlags values. Defaults to headers, attachment list and attachment export (7); Bcc, inline resources and EML recovery are off.

    • maxInputBytes

      public long maxInputBytes
      Maximum input size in bytes. Defaults to 100 MiB; zero permits no input bytes.

    • maxDecodedBytes

      public long maxDecodedBytes
      Maximum decoded-content budget in bytes. Defaults to 256 MiB; zero is a zero limit.

    • maxHtmlBytes

      public long maxHtmlBytes
      Maximum generated HTML size in bytes. Defaults to 64 MiB; zero is a zero limit.

    • cancellationCallback

      public CEmailCancelCallback cancellationCallback
      Optional cooperative cancellation callback; defaults to null. The callback reference is copied into the result, so changing this field after conversion does not replace an existing result's callback.

      public CEmailOptions(CEmailOptions other)
